comparison.objective: Candidate configures and locks a gripper motion limit; PR-2252 refits and latches a heavy range-hood baffle filter.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires seated driver/wrench coordination that prevents a screw setting from drifting during nut tightening; PR-2252 requires carrying an awkward slab, seating its bottom edge in a trough, swinging it flush, and operating a spring latch.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades target opening, lock retention, repeated motion, drift, hardware retention, and final clearance; PR-2252 grades trough engagement, flush seating, latch return over the filter, release, and one-second stability.
comparison.reason: PR-2252’s placement-and-latching outcome does not test torque-coupled adjustment preservation or repeated functional retention; no material comparison rubric detail is missing.
